pages.title: About
pages.content:
Teisha Parking began in 2009 at 18 Canal Street, Northgate, with one car park and a simple idea: a driver who parks every day should have a bay that is theirs. Today six town car parks and 412 monthly bays are looked after by a team of six.

Mara Lindqvist, the founder, still walks every site with each new driver before a contract is signed.

pages.title: Contact
pages.content:
Tell us which car park you prefer, your vehicle and the month you would like to start. We reply within two working days.

Office: 18 Canal Street, Northgate. Mon–Sat 9:00–18:00, closed Sundays and holidays.

pages.title: Newsletter
pages.content: Join the waitlist for a full site. We write to you when a bay opens at the car park you chose, and not otherwise.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.content: We keep the details you send in a bay request only to answer that request and to run your contract. We do not sell them or share them for advertising.

pages.title: Terms
pages.content: Monthly bays are let under a written agreement that starts on the 1st or 15th of the month and ends with thirty days' notice. The agreement you sign is the one that applies.

pages.title: Thank you
pages.content: Thank you. We have your request and will reply within two working days.

posts.title: The nurse on nights
posts.excerpt: After shifts that end past midnight, a sheltered bay by the platform makes the way home quiet and dependable.
posts.content:
Finishing a hospital shift after midnight means the last thing she wants is to look for a space. A covered bay at Northgate Station, a short walk from the platform, has made the journey home quiet and dependable.

She chose it on a site walk with Mara Lindqvist, who checked the lighting at the hour she actually leaves.

posts.title: Two vans, one bakery
posts.excerpt: A town bakery needs wide bays and early access, and two delivery vans load at Riverside Depot every morning.
posts.content:
A small bakery loads before dawn and needs room to turn. Riverside Depot gives its two vans wide bays and an automatic gate that works at any hour.

The bakery took both bays on one agreement, starting on the 1st.

posts.title: Charging by the library
posts.excerpt: Working across several town offices, one driver keeps an assigned charging bay at Library Square for the day and overnight.
posts.content:
Moving between town offices makes charging part of the working day. An assigned EV bay at Library Square means the car is ready when she is.

The bay costs €165 a month, with the same thirty days' notice as every other.
